summary: A phone layout built for the cockpit: map tools in one rail, your departure and arrival charts one tap away, and a cleaner map.
releaseNotes: Phone Flight Deck: a tray above the tab bar pins your departure and arrival airports with their charts, plus a Sync with flight switch.
Phone Flight Deck: the map tools sit in one rail on the left, with search opening beside it on demand.
Phone tab bar: Map, Plan, Flights, Charts and More, so every label has room; More holds the EFB apps, Airports, Weather and Profile.
Phone map labels no longer pile up: a label without room is left out, and navaids appear one zoom step later.
The EFB flight planner on a phone shows airports and your route when zoomed out, adding navaids and fixes as you zoom in.
Phone: the Flight Deck search no longer runs under the map buttons.
Phone: the EFB home dock no longer covers the last row of apps.
Phone: the floating Plan button and the empty flight plan and procedures cards are gone from the map; the Plan tab opens the planner.
